instruction: Change the essay title font size to 16 points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the title font size to 16pt. Evaluator verifies that paragraph 0 ('Example essay') has font size of 16pt.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_file fetches the DOCX file from VM after postconfig saves it
Postconfig is appropriate: activates window and saves file with Ctrl+S to persist changes
Metric checks the correct paragraph (index 0 = title) for font size 16pt
Expected values are semantically correct for the instruction
Minor logical weakness: metric returns 1.0 if ANY run in the paragraph has 16pt font, not ALL runs. This could cause false positives if only part of the title is changed to 16pt
Edge case: metric doesn't verify that all text in the title has 16pt font, only that at least one run does
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking that ALL runs (or all non-empty runs) in the paragraph have the expected font size, not just any run
Add a check to verify run.text is non-empty before checking font size
Alternative approach: check that the majority of text (by character count) has the expected font size
